metrics.description: This metric shows the percentage of CPU utilization. Under 20% green, over 80% red.

job.template: CPU_UTILIZATION = data("CPUUtilization", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/Redshift") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("ClusterIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}).mean(by=["ClusterIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the percentage of disk space used. Under 20% green, over 80% red.

job.template: DISK_SPACE_USED = data("PercentageDiskSpaceUsed", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/Redshift") and filter("stat", "mean"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}})

metrics.description: This metric shows the health of the cluster. If the cluster is healthy, it returns 1 every minute, else it returns value less than 1. Green color when value is 1 and red for value less than 1.

job.template: HEALTH_STATE = data("HealthStatus", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/Redshift") and filter("stat", "count") and filter("ClusterIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}},rollup="rate").min(by=["ClusterIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows when your cluster is unavailable because of maintenance work and it returns value greater than 0 when the cluster is under maintenance. Green color when value is 0 and red for value greater than 0.

job.template: MAINTENANCE_MODE = data("MaintenanceMode", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/Redshift") and filter("stat", "upper") and filter("ClusterIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}).max(by=["ClusterIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the rate at which the node or cluster receives data in bytes/sec. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: NETWORK_REC_TP = data("NetworkReceiveThroughput", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/Redshift") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("ClusterIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}).mean(by=["ClusterIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the rate at which the node or cluster writes data in bytes/sec. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: NETWORK_TRANS_TP = data("NetworkTransmitThroughput", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/Redshift") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("ClusterIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}).mean(by=["ClusterIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the average number of disk read operations per second. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: READ_IOPS = data("ReadIOPS", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/Redshift") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("ClusterIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}).mean(by=["ClusterIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the average amount of time taken for disk read I/O operations in milliseconds. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: READ_LATENCY = data("ReadLatency", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/Redshift") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("ClusterIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}).scale(1000).mean(by=["ClusterIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the average number of bytes read from disk per second. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: READ_THROUGHPUT = data("ReadThroughput", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/Redshift") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("ClusterIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}).mean(by=["ClusterIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the average number of write operations per second. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: WRITE_IOPS = data("WriteIOPS", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/Redshift") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("ClusterIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}).mean(by=["ClusterIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the average amount of time taken in milliseconds for disk write I/O operations. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: WRITE_LATENCY = data("WriteLatency", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/Redshift") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("ClusterIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}).scale(1000).mean(by=["ClusterIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the average number of bytes written to disk per second. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: WRITE_THROUGHPUT = data("WriteThroughput", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/Redshift") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("ClusterIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}).mean(by=["ClusterIdentifier"])

uiModel.o11ySignalflowTemplate: A = data('CPUUtilization', filter=filter('namespace', 'AWS/Redshift') and filter('stat', 'mean') and filter('ClusterIdentifier', '*')).mean(by=['ClusterIdentifier']).count().publish(label='A')
